wiki.title: Ashley Tackett Laferty
wiki.extract: Ashley Nicole Tackett Laferty (born May 10, 1979) is an American attorney and politician serving as a member of the Kentucky House of Representatives from Kentucky's 95th House district. Elected in November 2018, she assumed office on January 1, 2019.
